methods.label: Add in binary first
methods.explanation: Align the place values of \(1011\) and \(0110\). In binary, a column total of \(2\) is written as \(0\), with \(1\) carried to the next place. From right to left, the ones column gives \(1\), and each of the next three columns totals \(2\) after accounting for carries. Thus the sum is \(10001\) in binary, whose nonzero places have decimal values \(16\) and \(1\). The decimal sum is \(16+1=17\).
methods.levelReason: This alternative applies the elementary carry-at-two rule and binary place values, requiring no knowledge beyond the supplied Grade 7 numeral-system scope.
